# Hijauku project context

Read `AGENTS.md` and `docs/project-context.md` before editing. Use `docs/source-audit.md` for known facts and unresolved decisions; Jira and Stitch have not been accessible to the project owner during the last audit.

This repository is a Laravel 13 + Filament 5 starter. Preserve the existing domain boundaries and Indonesian user-facing text. The confirmed team has five members; Dinda is not on it. Jira currently has 45 stories for M01–M15 (9 per person) while HAP-61 still says 54 stories and six members; read `docs/source-audit.md` before changing scope. The course rule derives to at least 3 PBI/person/sprint (6 across two sprints for one minimum feature each), not 3 PBI/person for the whole project. Dusk covers the public-home flow, and active users in all three role enum cases can access the base panel. Add and test resource-level Policies before exposing data screens. Use transactions for quota/allocation operations and keep evidence files private. Update the relevant `docs/` file when requirements, architecture, or decisions change. Preserve `.env`; the owner reports local MySQL is working, but the shared engine decision is still open. Do not commit private data or credentials.
